ModMetaData.name: D'thorga Vehicles
ModMetaData.author: Phobos A. D'thorga
ModMetaData.description:
Vehicles that keep running only while they are looked after. It adds the bulk tanker, a heavy truck that carries liquids or gases depending on the tank you fit, and it gives the vehicles of other mods you already drive the right systems for what they really are.
What it does now:
- Heavy trucks with air brakes (Vanilla Vehicles Expanded's Big Rig, RimThunder's HEMTT) must idle a few minutes to build air before they can drive. - The Humvee runs a 24-volt electrical system with two batteries. - Tanks with gas-turbine engines (RimThunder's M1A2) have no radiator: their engines are air-cooled and burn hard even at idle. - The Harrier, the Hind, the Mongoose and the Cherokee run gas turbines with their real lift limits; the Frog, Toad and Goliath lose lift with each thruster out. - Steam locomotives (Trains of the Rim) raise steam over hours, need water stops and have a fusible plug; the Goat shunter is diesel-electric. - Military vehicles get their real engines, weights and gearboxes where published; Vanilla Vehicles Expanded's vehicles weigh what real ones of their kind weigh. - Modern vehicles have climate control; the Lightning can run on batteries with a setting.
Every other vehicle gets the general systems D'thorga Framework gives by what the vehicle runs on: battery and alternator, coolant and oil, tyres or tracks, brakes, gearbox, wear and service. More utility vehicles of our own (a survey truck, a drill rig, a tipper and a generator set), each with an upgrade tree, come later.
Needs Vehicle Framework and D'thorga Framework. Safe to add to a running colony. Safe to remove only if you have no bulk tanker: scrap it first. The named vehicles go back to the general systems.
